name: Lufeng

queries.query: Lufeng China official cadastral parcel map natural resources real estate registration GIS Guangdong
queries.result: First-party results identified the official Lufeng Natural Resources Bureau, its local real-estate registration custodian, and an official notice describing a map-based real-estate query service. The public service route was not available to an anonymous bounded request and no parcel ID-plus-geometry response was exposed.

queries.query: 陆丰市 不动产登记 地籍图 宗地图 自然资源 官方 GIS
queries.result: Native-language first-party results established Lufeng Natural Resources Bureau custody, the Lufeng Real Estate Registration Center, and official cadastral-boundary/registration notices. The official map-query notice points to a Guangdong public platform but states that real-name face authentication is used; no anonymous safe parcel geometry response was retrieved.

freshResearch.method: First-party web discovery followed by TLS-verified bounded GETs; no credentials, private tokens, login, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe-field request, or TLS disablement.

portalsFound.observation: Official Lufeng Natural Resources Bureau page lists unified natural-resources confirmation/registration, cadastral investigation, real-estate surveying, and a subordinate Lufeng Real Estate Registration Center. This evidences local registry custody, not an open parcel feature service.

Official Lufeng notice says Shanwei's public real-estate registration platform launched the map-based query service at the Guangdong route below; it describes map lookup and limited natural-property/encumbrance results and says real-name face authentication is used. It does not publish a safe anonymous parcel feature schema or geometry response.

Official Lufeng notice from the local real-estate registration center references cadastral-survey rules and attached parcel maps for registration-boundary notices, establishing local procedure evidence but not a public vector endpoint.

requests.assessment: Official custodian/function page loaded; no viewer configuration, parcel layer, schema, CRS, or anonymous geometry API exposed.
Official notice loaded; it documented the map-query route and authentication/privacy limits, but no public service JavaScript/configuration or safe parcel response was exposed.
Bounded request returned an empty reply; no response body, schema, CRS, ID field, or geometry. This is an unavailable route result, not evidence of parcel absence.
TLS-verified bounded request returned HTTP 502 from the network access gateway; no viewer JavaScript/configuration or parcel response was obtained. No certificate exception was used.

Official cadastral-boundary notice loaded and references attached parcel-map images; the images are not retained because they are not safe machine-readable parcel geometry and include registration context.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Lufeng City local natural-resources and real-estate-registration administration in Shanwei, Guangdong, China.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Local registry custody and official map-query procedure evidence only; anonymous parcel geometry, service schema/CRS, and citywide open coverage were not verified.

remainingUncertainty: The current public platform route, authentication/access controls, viewer JavaScript/configuration, parcel schema, CRS, stable native parcel identity, update currency, geometry quality, and citywide coverage remain unresolved. The exact WUP point was preserved and never shifted; no exact-point hit or miss inference was made. Registration notices contain owner/address and other sensitive context, which was not retained in the packet.
